articles.snippet: De visvijver aan de Halve Maan in Beveren-Kruibeke-Zwijndrecht bevat te veel vervuild slib met zware metalen en PFAS. De gemeente wil dat al langer aanpakken. articles.title: U-turn on EV policy could stall UK’s take-up of EVs | Fiona Harvey and Jasper Jolly
articles.snippet: The 2030 target for 80% of new cars to have zero emissions could be cut to as low as half Electric cars make people happy. More than nine in 10 EV drivers – 94% in a recent poll – are saving money, and a similar number would stick with electric for their next purchase, and recommend them to family and friends. Sales are soaring: more than half of the new cars sold in the UK last month were electric, if hybrids are taken into account, and about 28% of new car sales overall were electric only.
